tei:div.tei:p: legs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal te/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal 'byung ba'i mdzod/ /bdud rtsi dri med gsal bar bya/ /dus bzhi gnad kyi gdams pa dang*/ khregs chod thod rgal rnam gnyis kyi/ /gnad ni rnam pa gsum dag las/ /dang po dus bzhi'i gnad la gsum/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba 'o/ /dang po phyi yi dus bzhi ni/ /dgun dpyid dbyar dang ston rnams la/ /zla ba dag ni gsum gsum mo/ /dgun dus chu ste grang shas che/ /gnas dang spyod lam drod dang bstun/ /dpyid ni bad kan sa yi dus/ /lci zhing 'thibs pas bsang ba gces/ /dbyar me tsha bas bsil bar brten/ /ston rlung g.yo bas gsal dwangs phyed/ /gnas dang spyod lam ci 'phrod brten/ /nang gi dus bzhi rang lus kyi/ /'byung bzhi gnad kyi rim pa las/ /nyin mtshan cha ni bzhi bzhir dbye/ /nyin dus cir snang sgyu ma dang*/ /'od gsal ngang du rtsal sbyang zhing*/ /mtshan dus shes pa nang du gzung*/ /srod la lte ba'i a dmar las/ /me 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ la reg /bdud rtsi dkar dmar snying kar babs/ /thig le mchog la sems gzung bas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char/ /gung la seng ge'i nyal thabs kyis/ /snying nang a dkar sems gzung la/ /mi dmigs ngang du gnyid log bya/ /tho rangs a dkar snying nang nas/ /spyi gtsug 'phar te gzhu gang gi /nam mkha'i dkyil du gnas pa la/ /sems gzung gsal stong ye shes 'char/ /gsang ba'i dus bzhi rnam rtog gi /bzhi cha gsum bral chos sku la/ /rang rig ye shes ma yengs bsgom/ /snga phyi bar gsum dus gsum gyi/ / rnam rtog 'phro 'du rang chad do/ /mi rtog ye shes nyid dang sbyar/ /de ltar dus bzhi'i gnad goms pas/ /yang dag don la nye bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa khregs chod gnad la ni/ /shar nas rang gzhag gnad du che/ /mchod pas dus gnad nges pa las/ /mi 'gyu rang yal sus shes pa/ /'di la rtag med chad pa med/ /dran bsam bral ba sus shes pa/

/'di la 'gro med 'ong ba med/ /cer mthong rang ngo sus shes pa/ /'di la 'khor med myang 'das med/ /'di ltar sems kyi dngos po gces/ /zhes gsungs shar nas ngos zin pa'i/ /ngang dwangs sgom pa gsang ba'i gnad/ /gsum pa thod rgal gnad la ni/ /'dug stangs gzigs stangs rab gcun te/ /ma byed ma rmugs ma 'phros par/ /nyin mtshan snang ba'i 'od gsal bsgom/ /thabs las shes rab dngos su skye/ /nyin mtshan bsre ba gnad du che/ /mi rtog gsal dwangs phyed pa ni/ /chos sku'i 'od gsal snying por bshad/ /de nyid nyams su blangs pa yis/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por grol/ /de ltar gnad gsum gdams pa'i mchog /rgyud lung man ngag gnad bsdus nas/ / bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /lhun grub kun tu bzang por shog /'od gsal sgom pa'i gnad yig / bdud rtsi dri med ces bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ bla ma yang tig bdud rtsi dri med/ PAGE - 432 -- PAGE 109 - - PAGE 108 -
